bio: Sarah Trone Garriott is an American politician and minister who is the U.S. representative-elect for Iowa's 3rd congressional district. A member of the Democratic Party, she is also serving as a member of the Iowa Senate from the 14th district since 2021, representing part of Dallas County in the Des Moines area and served previously as Senate minority whip.
offices: Member of the State Senate of Iowa (2021–present)
